question: Approve DEV-51 to enter Pilot ideation: replace the contract test's phrase pins with behaviour assertions a mutation can redden?

artifacts.summary: Recommend approval: Linear DEV-51 bound (Todo, Cycle 2, Project kc-dev-flow slimming dogfood, sprint S8); Pilot receipt with route shape, build, verify-deliver; semantics_unchanged true so validation must name the equivalence instrument, which is this item's own deliverable. Two-tier instrument: deterministic assertions on loader, guard, and close-guard outputs; behavior-diff sampling for agent-only prose; wording-only pins recorded with reasons. No pin removed before its replacement reddened on the same removal; per-case behavior-diff cost measured. Scope excludes contract slimming, a generic harness, model-backed CI checks, and loader or guard behaviour changes.
